pictures.scene: Johann Martin von Rohden, Bei Subiaco - the monastery standing high on the pale cliff above the wooded ravine with the white waterfall below it and a monk climbing the rock path up towards the door cut in the cliff, a song of ascents
pictures.name: pd_rohden_opgang

pictures.scene: Adam de Coster, A Man Singing by Candlelight - the man singing with his mouth open from the great sheet of music held open across his chest, holding up the one lit candle that shows it to him in the dark, come bless the LORD all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD
pictures.name: pd_coster_nacht

pictures.scene: Simon Denis, Study of Clouds with a Sunset near Rome - the great towering clouds lit along their edges by the last of the sun with the land lying low and quiet beneath them, lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD, may the LORD the Maker of heaven and earth
pictures.name: pd_denis_hemel

pictures.scene: Richard Wilson, Dinas Bran from Llangollen - the stronghold standing on the crown of the hill above the wooded valley with the stone bridge and the river below it, bless you from Zion
pictures.name: pd_wilson_sion
